// fixture: clean-allowed-calls. Fictional family Asha; not compiled, read by test/media-ast-scan.test.ts as text.
// as: apps/mobile/src/lib/media/fixture.ts
// expect: none
import { getPermissionsAsync, requestPermissionsAsync } from 'expo-media-library';
import { launchImageLibraryAsync } from 'expo-image-picker';
import { toNativeErrorCode } from './native-error';

export async function ashaAccess(ask: boolean) {
  try {
    const status = ask ? await requestPermissionsAsync() : await getPermissionsAsync();
    return status.granted;
  } catch (e) {
    return toNativeErrorCode(e);
  }
}
export const pickOne = () => launchImageLibraryAsync({ allowsMultipleSelection: false });
